"# Implementation Plan: Linux Mint OS with Inbuilt Offline Laptop Controller Agent & GitHub Auto-Sync

This project accomplishes two interconnected objectives:
1. **GitHub Repository & Continuous Conversation Sync Engine**: Completely storing this work to a new dedicated GitHub repository (`thakoralpesh3/mint-agent-os`) and establishing an automated synchronization daemon that tracks this conversation's transcripts, artifacts, and codebase in real time, auto-committing and pushing updates to GitHub.
2. **Linux Mint AI OS with Inbuilt Offline Agent**: Architecting and building **MintPilot** (an autonomous offline agent capable of total laptop control) embedded into a customized, bootable Linux Mint OS distribution and ISO remastering suite.

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Hardware Compatibility & Model Selection**:
> - Your current machine has an **Intel Core i3-4005U (2 cores, 1.70 GHz)** with **3.7 GB RAM** and **Intel Integrated Graphics**.
> - Running 7B+ LLMs locally on this hardware would freeze the system. Therefore, our offline agent architecture uses a **Dynamic Hardware-Adaptive Model Tier**:
>   - **Tier 1 (Ultra-Light / Low RAM - Default for 4GB RAM)**: `Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct` (~400MB RAM) or `Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Q4_K_M` (~1.1GB RAM) using quantized GGUF via `llama.cpp` for rapid CPU inference.
>   - **Tier 2 (Balanced - for 8GB+ RAM)**: `Qwen2.5-3B` or `Llama-3.2-3B`.
>   - **Tier 3 (High-End - for 16GB+ RAM / GPU)**: `Qwen2.5-7B` or `Mistral-Nemo-12B`.
> - The OS will automatically detect the host laptop's CPU, GPU, and RAM at boot and select the optimal model tier.

> [!NOTE]
> **Target Desktop Environment for the Custom Linux Mint OS**:
> - We recommend **Linux Mint Cinnamon** (or **XFCE Edition** for ultra-lightweight performance on older laptops). The agent tools support both X11 and Cinnamon/XFCE window managers.

---

"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
MintPilot Master Agent Daemon
Runs in the background, hosts the system tray icon, listens for global hotkey triggers,
and provides a Unix domain socket server for instant CLI communication.
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import socket
import threading
from pathlib import Path

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT_DIR))

import gi
gi.require_version('Gtk', '3.0')
from gi.repository import Gtk, GLib

from agent.brain.inference import AgentBrain
from agent.ui.tray_applet import MintTrayApplet

SOCKET_PATH = "/tmp/mint_agent.sock"


class AgentDaemon:
    def __init__(self):
        self.brain = AgentBrain()
        self.tray = MintTrayApplet()

    def start_socket_server(self):
        """Starts Unix domain socket listener for instant CLI requests."""
        if os.path.exists(SOCKET_PATH):
            os.remove(SOCKET_PATH)

        server = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        server.bind(SOCKET_PATH)
        server.listen(5)
        os.chmod(SOCKET_PATH, 0o777)

        def listen_loop():
            while True:
                try:
                    conn, _ = server.accept()
                    data = conn.recv(4096).decode('utf-8')
                    if data:
                        req = json.loads(data)
                        prompt = req.get("prompt", "")
                        res = self.brain.process_command(prompt)
                        conn.sendall(json.dumps(res).encode('utf-8'))
                    conn.close()
                except Exception as e:
                    pass

        t = threading.Thread(target=listen_loop, daemon=True)
        t.start()


def main():
    daemon = AgentDaemon()
    daemon.start_socket_server()
    print("🍃 MintPilot Master Agent Daemon active on Linux Mint.")
    Gtk.main()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"

> - **🛡️ Safe Mode (Guarded Alerting)**:

> - **Self-Defense Architecture**:

"# Implementation Plan: In-Place Linux Mint OS Updater & Offline/Online AI Model Switcher

This plan delivers two major capabilities for **MintPilot on Linux Mint**:
1. **OS Upgrade & Updater Option**: Enables users running standard Linux Mint (21.x / 22.x) to transform their OS into MintPilot Agent OS with a 1-line script or in-place CLI/WebUI update.
2. **Offline & Online AI Model Customization**: Empowers users to customize, select, and switch between offline local SLMs (Qwen2.5 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, local GGUF) and online cloud models (Google Gemini 2.5, OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, custom endpoints) via WebUI, CLI, and natural language.

---

## Architecture Overview

```mermaid
graph TD
    User([User]) --> UI[WebUI Model Selector / CLI / Natural Language]
    UI --> MM[ModelManager Core]

        OfflineEng --> Tier3[Tier 3: Qwen2.5 7B GGUF]
        OfflineEng --> CustomGGUF[User Local .gguf file / Ollama]
    end

    subgraph "Online AI Execution (Cloud LLM APIs)"
        MM --> OnlineEng[Online API Dispatcher]
        OnlineEng --> Gemini[Google Gemini 2.5 Flash / Pro]
        OnlineEng --> OpenAI[OpenAI GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini]
        OnlineEng --> Claude[Anthropic Claude 3.5 Haiku / Sonnet]
        OnlineEng --> CustomAPI[Custom Base URL / LocalAI / OpenRouter]
    end

    OnlineEng -.->|Internet Down / API Key Missing| OfflineEng
```

---
